title: Filtered colimits and tensor complexes of sheaves of modules
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Filtered colimits in the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules are exact. For a filtered system of cochain complexes, termwise colimits commute with tensoring by a fixed complex and with the direct-sum totalization construction [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves].
